projectGates.summary: No em dash (U+2014) in UI microcopy or skill text.
No fabricated stats, testimonials, AI avatars or unverified security claims.
No dead links, buttons or navbar anchors.
No UI features implemented by scripts that patch source or CSS with string replacement.
No eyebrow capsule badges or floating pill banners above headlines.
No generic template layouts such as hero plus three cards.
Deliver a PASS/FAIL report with interactive verification, guard exit codes and a purpose log.

skills.name: modern-web-guidance
skills.description:
Search tool for modern web development best practices. MANDATORY: Execute FIRST for all HTML/CSS and clientside JS tasks. Do NOT skip — web APIs evolve rapidly and training weights contain obsolete patterns.
Trigger immediately for: modals/dialogs/popovers, tables, dark mode, anchor positioning, container queries, view transitions, scroll-driven animations, parallax/reveals, forms, validation, autofill, accessibility, custom selects, scrollbars, CWV (LCP, INP, CLS), content-visibility, fetch priority, image optimization, security, passkeys, HTML sanitization, web components, dates/timezones, built-in AI, WebAssembly, standard HTML/CSS/DOM in frameworks, etc.
DO NOT trigger for: backend (SQL, ORMs, API routes), infra/scripts (CI/CD, Docker, Actions, Python/Go, Git), or tooling/trivial (Vite, tsconfig, ESLint, tests, copy/renames, 3P docs), etc.

skills.name: maplibre-cartography
skills.description: Cartographic principles for MapLibre GL JS — label and symbol legibility on imagery vs. vector basemaps, figure-ground for point icons, styling vector roads over aerial imagery, visual hierarchy, layer ordering for data injection, and accessibility. Use when styling a map, choosing text or symbol colors, making markers or roads readable on satellite/aerial imagery, or ordering layers correctly.

skills.name: maplibre-fonts-glyphs
skills.description: Configuring fonts and glyphs for MapLibre GL JS and MapLibre Native — the style's `glyphs` URL, self-hosting or generating font PBFs, the GL JS local-font fallback (omitted `glyphs` or a failed glyph fetch), the `font-faces` property both SDKs read, and CJK, right-to-left and Devanagari script handling. Use when text labels aren't rendering in the intended font, setting up a glyphs server, choosing between self-hosting and generating font PBFs, or handling non-Latin scripts.

skills.name: maplibre-mapbox-migration
skills.description: Migrating from Mapbox GL JS to MapLibre GL JS — package, import and namespace changes, removing the access token, replacing mapbox:// styles, tile sources, plugin equivalents (draw, geocoder, directions, compare), and Mapbox v2-only APIs such as setFog and the free camera. Use when moving an existing Mapbox map to MapLibre, or when a migrated map shows a blank map, a mapbox:// or 401 error, or a missing Mapbox method or plugin.

skills.name: maplibre-native-gl-js-parity
skills.description: Six places where MapLibre Native (Android, iOS) and MapLibre GL JS differ, release by release — custom URL schemes (`addProtocol`), globe projection, 3D terrain, `interpolate-hcl` and `interpolate-lab`, the `color-relief` layer, and PMTiles — with the Native release that closed each gap, the tracking issue for each still open, and what to do on Native instead. Use when a style or feature that works in the browser does nothing in an Android or iOS app, or when porting MapLibre GL JS code to Kotlin or Swift.

skills.name: maplibre-pmtiles-patterns
skills.description: Serverless vector and raster tiles with PMTiles for MapLibre GL JS — single-file format, HTTP range requests, hosting on S3/R2/GitHub Pages, generating with Planetiler or tippecanoe, and the pmtiles protocol. Use when you need no tile server or want to host tiles from static storage.

skills.name: maplibre-skill-authoring
skills.description: How to turn a working session into a MapLibre agent skill — you researched something MapLibre's docs did not cover, got it wrong before you got it right, shipped it, and the session is about to end. Covers what to capture while the context is still live, how to separate the durable claim from the project it came from, and where to hand it off. Use at the end of a MapLibre task that took real research, or when asked to capture one as a skill.

skills.name: maplibre-source-wiring
skills.description: Getting a MapLibre GL JS source to actually render — TileJSON `url` versus hand-wired `tiles` templates, matching `source-layer` names to the tile schema, layer order and inserting below labels, `promoteId` and the feature ids that feature state needs, and the CORS and glyph failures behind a blank map. Use when a source is configured but nothing is drawing, or when setFeatureState does nothing.

skills.name: maplibre-sprites-icons
skills.description: Sprites and icon images for MapLibre GL JS — choosing a `Marker`, a sprite, or `addImage`; the `sprite` base URL and its `{id, url}` array form for several sheets; self-hosting and building sprites; runtime images, SVGs included, with `addImage`; finding a missing icon with the console warning and `hasImage`; and route shields that render as bare numbers. Use when deciding how to put icons on a map, when a symbol layer's icons never appear, when adding your own icons to a style whose sprite you do not control, or when shields are missing their badge.

skills.name: maplibre-terrain-rendering
skills.description: Drawing elevation in MapLibre GL JS once a raster-dem source works — hillshade and `hillshade-method`, the `color-relief` layer and the `["elevation"]` expression, runtime contours with `maplibre-contour`, and 3D terrain with its camera, sky, fog and haze. Use when relief looks harsh, flat, or absent, when the horizon is blank or a Mapbox `setFog` call fails after migrating, or when the layer type or property for an elevation effect is unclear.

skills.name: maplibre-tile-sources
skills.description: Choosing what form your data needs for MapLibre GL JS — GeoJSON read straight from a file versus vector or raster tiles, the feature-count and file-size thresholds where each stops working, how a basemap and your own data combine as separate sources, and what a Leaflet app needs to draw vector tiles. Use when deciding which source type a dataset needs, not when hosting or configuring one.

skills.name: maplibre-v6-migration
skills.description: Upgrading a MapLibre GL JS app from v5 to v6 — the ESM-only build, the removed default export, CommonJS require() breakage, the styleimagemissing/setMissingStyleImageResolver change, the removal of the internal map.transform, the MapDataEvent → MapSourceDataEvent/MapStyleDataEvent split, and the bundler-only setWorkerUrl() requirement. Use when a v5 app breaks after upgrading to v6, or before pinning a v6 install.

skills.name: racepulse-gps-precision
skills.description: Calibrate and harden GPS and GNSS tracking across browser geolocation, Capacitor Android FusedLocationProviderClient, Kalman smoothing, and course map-matching. Use when GPS is inaccurate, drifting, lagging, jumping, or failing field capture.

deferredTopics.reason: Managed by Firebase Hosting and Cloud Functions (with maxInstances caps covered in racepulse-delivery-performance).

deferredTopics.reason: Low relevance to a browser SPA plus Node.js Functions. Revisit only if the C# rfid-bridge service expands into multi-threaded socket pooling.
